glosses: coming, arrival

examples.text: [À] peine les petits oiseaux nuancés de mille couleurs avaient-ils salué des harpes de leurs langues, dans une douce et mielleuse harmonie, la venue de l’aurore au teint de rose, ... que le fameux chevalier don Quichotte de la Manche ... prit sa route à travers l’antique et célèbre plaine de Montiel.
examples.translation: [S]carce had the little birds shaded of a thousand colours hailed from the harps of their tongues, in a soft and mellifluous harmony, the coming of the pink-tinted dawn, ... when the famous knight Don Quixote of La Mancha ... took his route across the ancient and famous Campo de Montiel.

glosses: The act of arriving (reaching a certain place).

examples.text: The early arrival of the bride created a stir.

glosses: The fact of reaching a particular point in time.

examples.text: He celebrated the arrival of payday with a shopping spree.

O gentlemen, the time of life is short!
To spend that shortness basely were too long,

glosses: The fact of beginning to occur; the initial phase of something.

examples.text: The arrival of puberty can be especially challenging for transgender youth.

examples.text: The arrival of the railway made the local tourist industry viable.
